name: s2k_addLoadCaseToLoadComb
formula: =LAMBDA(loadCombName,caseName,scaleFactor,TEXTJOIN("   ", FALSE, "ComboName=" & CHAR(34) & loadCombName & CHAR(34), "CaseName=" & CHAR(34) & caseName & CHAR(34), "ScaleFactor=" & scaleFactor))
comment: Returns one COMBINATION DEFINITIONS record, fields separated by three spaces: ComboName="loadCombName", CaseName="caseName", ScaleFactor=scaleFactor. Arguments: loadCombName, caseName, scaleFactor. No error branch. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
